'''''Opuntia dillenii''''' is a species of [[Opuntia|prickly pear]] native to the tropical and subtropical [[Americas]]. It is naturalized in many other parts of the world.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|title=''Opuntia dillenii'' (Ker Gawl.) Haw.|url=http://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:136534-1|accessdate=2021-03-11|website=Plants of the World Online|publisher=Kew Science}}</ref> It differs from ''[[Opuntia stricta|O. stricta]]'' by having more spines per arose (usually more than 3).<ref>{{Cite web|title=缩刺仙人掌 ''Opuntia stricta''（中国植物志）|url=http://www.iplant.cn/info/Opuntia%20stricta?t=z|accessdate=2021-03-11|website=iPlant 植物智——植物物种信息系统|publisher=中国科学院植物研究所系统与进化植物学国家重点实验室|language=zh}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|last=Pardo|first=Francisco María Vázquez|last2=Alonso|first2=David García|year=2017|title=Aproximación al conocimiento del grupo ''Opuntia'' Mill.
